item.title: 04. Same Claude, different cloud
item.description: Buying Claude through Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud or Microsoft Foundry instead of direct: who operates each, which features it carries, where the data goes, and which commitment it draws down. Plus AWS's own stack: Nova, AgentCore, Strands and Kiro.

item.title: 03. Microsoft: competitor and channel
item.description: Microsoft sells against Claude and sells Claude: the two ways to host Claude in Foundry, Microsoft Agent Framework, Claude inside Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Cowork, and GitHub Copilot against Claude Code.

item.title: 02. Google
item.description: Gemini on six layers: the widest multimodal range in the field, two developer front doors, an open agent kit and the A to A protocol, Antigravity in place of Gemini CLI and Jules, and Gemini Enterprise with Claude switched on inside it.

item.title: 01. OpenAI
item.description: OpenAI on all six layers: the Astra-to-Luna model tiers, the Responses API and agent stack, Codex and ChatGPT Work, ChatGPT Enterprise, and its models on Azure and Bedrock. Where OpenAI is stronger than Claude, where Claude leads, and the questions to ask a customer.

item.title: 00. The map: six layers for comparing AI vendors
item.description: Six layers for comparing any AI vendor with Claude, how to read a benchmark and a market report without being fooled, which facts are safe to quote and which to check first, and the route through the series.
